item.title: Anchorage Weather: Overnight
item.description:
38°F | 10 to 15 mph | SE | Light Rain Likely

Rain likely. Cloudy, with a low around 38. Southeast wind 10 to 15 mph, with gusts as high as 25 mph. Chance of precipitation is 80%.

item.title: Anchorage Weather: Thursday
item.description:
51°F | 0 to 10 mph | N | Chance Light Rain then Mostly Cloudy

A chance of rain before 7am. Mostly cloudy, with a high near 51. North wind 0 to 10 mph. Chance of precipitation is 40%.

item.title: Anchorage Weather: Thursday Night
item.description:
37°F | 5 mph | N | Light Rain Likely

Rain likely between 10pm and 4am. Cloudy, with a low around 37. North wind around 5 mph. Chance of precipitation is 70%.

item.title: ABC Business: Russian oil to Slovakia resumes flowing through pipeline that crosses Ukraine
item.description: Slovak Economy Minister Denisa Saková says the flow of Russian oil to Slovakia through the Druzhba pipeline that crosses Ukraine has resumed

item.title: ABC Business: New York Times says FBI investigated reporter after article about director Kash Patel's girlfriend
item.description: The New York Times says it has learned that the FBI investigated one of its reporters, Elizabeth Williamson, after she wrote about its agents being assigned to protect and transport the girlfriend of that agency's director, Kash Patel

item.title: ABC Business: Asian stocks retreat and oil tops $100 despite fresh records on Wall St
item.description: Asian stocks have retreated while oil prices gained as investors reacted to shaky prospects for more talks on ending the war with Iran

item.title: ABC Business: European Union ramps up crisis testing, convinced that Trump's security priorities lie elsewhere
item.description: The European Union is preparing to test rules that require member countries to assist each other during crises

item.title: ABC Business: Colombia's leader to visit Venezuela for key talks with acting President Delcy Rodríguez
item.description: Colombian President Gustavo Petro is visiting Venezuela for key talks on border security and trade with the country's acting president, Delcy Rodríguez
